metadata.name: openpump_fees
metadata.description: OpenPump fees program: tiered fee schedule, creator fee sharing, social/donation fee PDAs, buyback vaults

instructions.name: admin_cto_sharing_config
docs: Protocol authority: reset or pause a sharing config (community takeover of abandoned coins).

instructions.name: claim_social_fee_pda
docs: The social-claim authority (after verifying the social login off-chain) pays the PDA's SOL
to the user's wallet. Rate limited per PDA.

instructions.name: claim_social_fee_pda_v2
docs: Same for a custom-pair quote token held in the PDA's ATA.

instructions.name: crank_donation_fee_pda
docs: Permissionless: forward everything the PDA holds (SOL above rent) to the beneficiary.

instructions.name: create_donation_fee_pda
docs: A creator routes their coin's creator fee to `beneficiary` (set the coin's creator to this PDA
via the curve's `set_creator`; the PDA address is deterministic from mint + beneficiary).

accounts.name: base_mint
docs: can name it as creator.

instructions.name: create_fee_sharing_config
docs: The coin's creator turns their creator fee into a shared stream. Reassigns the coin's creator
(curve, and the AMM pool if graduated) to this SharingConfig PDA; starts with 100 % to the creator.

accounts.name: payer
docs: Must be the coin's current creator.

accounts.name: pool
docs: Graduated coins: the migration pool, so the AMM-side creator is reassigned as well.

instructions.name: get_fees
docs: View: fees for a trade (returned through return data).

instructions.name: revoke_fee_sharing_authority
docs: Lock the split forever.

instructions.name: sweep_buyback
docs: The buyback authority takes the accrued SOL to execute buybacks (rate limited).

instructions.name: sweep_buyback_quote
docs: The buyback authority takes the quote tokens (AMM buyback share, e.g. WSOL) accrued in the vault's ATA.

instructions.name: update_fee_shares
docs: Admin sets a new split. Pending fees are paid to the *previous* shareholders first by the
caller (client does `distribute_creator_fees` in the same transaction); on-chain we only
require the vault to be empty so nobody's accrued share is re-split.

instructions.name: upsert_fee_tiers
docs: Replace tiers starting at `offset` (pump's upsert semantics).

instructions.name: withdraw
docs: Authority withdraws stray SOL sent to the fee config PDA.

errors.name: TiersNotSorted
errors.msg: Tiers must be sorted ascending by threshold

errors.name: HolderRewardCoin
errors.msg: Holder-reward coins cannot share creator fees

errors.name: VaultNotEmpty
errors.msg: Distribute pending fees before changing the split

fields.name: quote_mint
docs: Pubkey::default() = native SOL curve; otherwise the SPL/Token-2022 quote mint (v2 family).

fields.name: is_holder_reward
docs: If set, `creator` is the ["holder-rewards", mint] PDA and the creator fee is paid out to holders.

fields.name: creator_fee_bps
docs: Per-coin creator fee override (bps). 0 = follow the fee schedule.

fields.name: flat_fees
docs: Used when no tier applies / for foreign pools.

fields.name: fee_tiers
docs: SOL-quoted coins (sorted ascending by threshold).

fields.name: stable_fee_tiers
docs: Coins quoted in a stable mint listed in `stable_mints`.

fields.name: exotic_flat_fees
docs: Any other quote mint (custom pairs).

fields.name: market_cap_lamports_threshold
docs: Market cap (in quote base units, i.e. lamports for SOL) from which this tier applies.

fields.name: protocol_fees
docs: Lifetime stats (informational).

fields.name: creator_fee_bps
docs: Per-pool creator fee override (bps). 0 = follow the schedule.

fields.name: virtual_quote_reserves
docs: Quote parked in the boost vault but still priced as if in the pool (see boost.rs).

types.name: SharingConfig
docs: Per-coin creator fee split. When a coin's `creator` is this PDA, its creator fees accrue in the
PDA's creator vault and `distribute_creator_fees` (curve / AMM) pays the shareholders.
